test_lp_primal_ising: test the primal LP-MAP solver on a fully connected Ising model with grid_size and n_iters parameters
test_lp_primal_rbm: test the primal LP-MAP solver on a Restricted Boltzmann Machine with hidden and visible variables
build_factorgraph_ising: build a fully connected factor graph for an Ising model using NDVarArray and PairwiseFactorGroup
build_factorgraph_rbm: build a factor graph for an RBM with EnumFactorGroup unaries and PairwiseFactorGroup pairwise factors
solve_primal_lp: solve MAP inference via primal LP solver using primal_lp_solver and decode results with infer.decode_map_states
